info.title: places service
info.description:
Addresses: geocoding with a cache, saved places, search history. Owns schema `places`.
Saved places and history are personal data; a user reads and changes only their own rows
(other users' rows answer `404`, so their existence is not revealed).

`x-access`: access level at the gateway (`internal` = not routed). `x-rate-limit`: per-minute
limit at the gateway.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description:
Request correlation id. The gateway creates one (UUID) when the client sends none and
forwards it; every service logs it, returns it and passes it on.

get.description:
Answers from the cache when possible; otherwise asks the geocoder (throttled) and caches
the result. If the geocoder is unavailable, only cached answers are returned.

schema.description: Three-letter city code.

200.description: Up to 5 candidates, best first. Empty when nothing was found.

400.description: The request is malformed or fails schema validation.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation id of the request (received or generated).
